swiftlet.mask_haloes.distribute_pixels(comm, nside)[source]

Verbatim copy of lightcone_io.smoothed_map.distribute_pixels that cannot be simply imported.

Split the HEALPix pixels between ranks.

Returns (nr_total_pixels, nr_local_pixels, local_offset, theta_boundary).

Parameters:

  • comm (mpi4py.MPI.Comm) – MPI communicator

  • nside (int) – nside of the map

swiftlet.mask_haloes.exchange_particles(part_dest, arrays)[source]

Verbatim copy of lightcone_io.smoothed_map.exchange_particles that cannot be simply imported.

Send each element of the arrays to its destination rank.

Returns a list of the arrays received by this rank.

Parameters:

  • part_dest (np.ndarray) – destination rank of each element

  • arrays (list) – 1D or 2D arrays to exchange between ranks

swiftlet.mask_haloes.get_num(x)[source]

swiftlet.mask_haloes.mask_cluster_apertures_local(nside, cluster_coords, radius_mpc, local_offset, nr_local_pixels)[source]

Stamp each halo’s aperture onto only a given rank’s slice of the sky.

global pixel indices [local_offset, local_offset + nr_local_pixels)

Returns the local mask, 0 inside a halo aperture and 1 otherwise. If zero haloes on rank, returns an all 1’s mask.

Parameters:

  • nside (int) – nside of the map

  • cluster_coords (np.ndarray) – Cartesian comoving positions [Mpc] relative to the observer, shape (N, 3)

  • radius_mpc (float or np.ndarray) – comoving aperture radius [Mpc] for each halo, or a single radius for all haloes

  • local_offset (int) – global index of the first pixel on this rank

  • nr_local_pixels (int) – number of pixels on this rank

swiftlet.mask_haloes.read_shell_halo_properties(halo_filenames, soap_filenames, snapshot_numbers, radius_prop, mass_prop, mass_unit_str, comm)[source]

MPI-parallel replacement for looping over each snapshot contributing to a shell.

Per shell:

  1. read a shell’s halo lightcone files in a single collective read

  2. Cross-reference each snapshot’s SOAP file, within the same snapshot,

    for radius_prop and mass_prop via InputHalos/SOAPIndex

  3. Convert the radius and mass properties from SOAP units to comoving Mpc and the given mass units

Returns a dict of local per-halo arrays.

Parameters:

  • halo_filenames (list) – halo lightcone files contributing to the shell

  • soap_filenames (list) – SOAP catalogue files, one per snapshot

  • snapshot_numbers (list or np.ndarray) – snapshot numbers of the SOAP catalogues

  • radius_prop (str) – path to the radius property in the SOAP catalogue, e.g. ‘SO/500_crit/SORadius’

  • mass_prop (str) – path to the mass property in the SOAP catalogue, e.g. ‘SO/500_crit/TotalMass’

  • mass_unit_str (str) – units to convert the mass property to, e.g. ‘Msun’

  • comm (mpi4py.MPI.Comm) – MPI communicator

swiftlet.mask_haloes.rotate_cluster_coords(cluster_coords, map_rotator_object)[source]

Rotate cluster 3D Cartesian comoving positions to match a sky.

Rotation has already been applied to a HEALPix map via rotate_map_fast and each cluster’s comoving distance from the observer is preserved.

Returns the cluster positions in the rotated frame, shape (N, 3), with the same distances and rotated directions.

Parameters:

  • cluster_coords (np.ndarray) – Cartesian comoving positions [Mpc] relative to the observer, shape (N, 3)

  • map_rotator_object (healpy.Rotator) – the SAME Rotator instance returned by rotate_map_fast for this shell/rotation. Do not construct a new one from theta/phi independently.

swiftlet.mask_haloes.route_halos_to_pixel_owners(theta_boundary, cluster_coords, radius_mpc, extra_arrays, comm)[source]

Determine which rank(s) each halo’s angular aperture could reach and send the halo to them.

Returns (recv_coords, recv_radius, recv_extra_arrays): this rank’s own halos plus every halo forwarded to it by other ranks whose aperture reaches this rank’s band.

Parameters:

  • theta_boundary (np.ndarray) – theta boundaries of each rank’s band of pixels, from distribute_pixels

  • cluster_coords (np.ndarray) – comoving positions, shape (N, 3), of this rank’s local halos only

  • radius_mpc (np.ndarray) – comoving aperture radius, shape (N,), for each halo.

  • extra_arrays (list) – additional 1D/2D per-halo arrays to carry

  • comm (mpi4py.MPI.Comm) – MPI communicator

swiftlet.mask_haloes.write_binary_masks(halo_cat_format, soap_cat_format, mass_poperty, radius_poperty, nshell, nside, latitudes, longitudes, lightcone_numbers, mask_filename, output_dir, comm, bin_method='both', mass_units='Msun', log_mass_bin_range=None, log_mass_bin_width=None, scale_radius=None, hdf5_dset_kwargs=<object object>)[source]

Write binary halo masks per shell to a .hdf5 file.

Parameters:

  • halo_cat_format (str) – formatted path to the halo lightcone files, with {lightcone_nr} and {snap_nr} fields

  • soap_cat_format (str) – formatted path to the SOAP catalogues, with a {snap_nr} field

  • mass_poperty (str) – path to SOAP catalogue values to use for the selection of haloes on the sky e.g. ‘SO/500_crit/TotalMass’ for M500c

  • radius_poperty (str) – path to values to use as the radius of each halo in the SOAP catalogue e.g. ‘SO/500_crit/SORadius’ for R500c

  • nshell (int) – number of shells to make masks for

  • nside (int) – nside of the masks

  • latitudes (unyt.unyt_array (units of deg or equivalent)) – latitude rotation angle per shell, applied to the halo positions

  • longitudes (unyt.unyt_array (units of deg or equivalent)) – longitude rotation angle per shell, applied to the halo positions

  • lightcone_numbers (list) – lightcone numbers to make masks for

  • mask_filename (str) – name of the output mask file, prefixed with the lightcone number and bin method

  • output_dir (str) – directory to write the masks to

  • comm (mpi4py.MPI.Comm) – MPI communicator

  • bin_method (str) –

    selects which mass-bin definition(s) to build masks with:

    • ’discrete’: M1 < log10(M) <= M2, where M1 and M2 are the edges of the mass bin

    • ’cumulative’: M1 < log10(M) <= Mmax, where Mmax is the maximum of log_mass_bin_range

    • ’both’: make 2 sets of masks, one for each bin method

  • mass_units (str) – units of the mass property given. Default is solar masses ‘Msun’

  • log_mass_bin_range (tuple) – log10 min and max values of the mass_poperty to bin haloes by. If None, then use default range of 12-16

  • log_mass_bin_width (float) – log10 width of the log10 mass bins. If None, then default is 0.5

  • scale_radius (list or np.ndarray) – coefficients to scale the given radius property by when drawing apertures about each halo. If None, then assume coefficients of 0.2, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 and 5.0

  • hdf5_dset_kwargs (dict) – keyword arguments passed to h5py create_dataset. If not given, use gzip compression level 9 with shuffle. If None, no compression
